paper_facts.title: Image Enhancement Based on Pigment Representation
paper_facts.method: content-adaptive RGB-to-many-positive-projections, per-projection piecewise-linear 1D reprojection, learned 1x1 blending, and learned RGB reconstruction
reported_boundary_gaps: no monotonicity constraint on the learned reprojection control values
no cube, Jacobian, inverse, severe-artifact, or strict output-boundary gate
the name pigment is a mathematical feature-space analogy, not a film-emulsion or dye-cloud model

project_overlap.untested_combination: parallel many-direction 1D curve basis with source-only parameter prediction and intrinsic strict-interior execution

decision: Allow one clean-room digital-retouch control pilot using only the paper-level many-projection idea. Do not copy unlicensed source or weights, call the representation physical pigment or film, or bypass the existing stock/data gates.
claim_ceiling: source-method reconnaissance and clean-room algorithm-family permission; not reproduction, license clearance, film evidence, stock response, calibration, preference, product promotion, or novelty
